title: Input schema for Retail Radar - MikeSport Lebanon Scraper
description: Run the mikesport scraper from the Retail Radar repo. The underlying store endpoint starts from https://lb.mikesport.com.

full.title: Full catalog mode
full.description: If true, scrape the full supported catalog. If false, sampleSize is used.

sampleSize.title: Sample size
sampleSize.description: How many products to scrape when full catalog mode is off.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Optional adapter page or sitemap cap for debugging.

saveJsonToKeyValueStore.title: Save JSON file
saveJsonToKeyValueStore.description: Save all records into OUTPUT_JSON in the default key-value store.

saveCsvToKeyValueStore.title: Save CSV file
saveCsvToKeyValueStore.description: Save all records into OUTPUT_CSV in the default key-value store.

saveSummaryToKeyValueStore.title: Save summary
saveSummaryToKeyValueStore.description: Save counts and run summary into OUTPUT_SUMMARY in the default key-value store.
